calu hone par YouTube Focus, Android ki AccessibilityService API se YouTube app mein dikha raha text aur controls parhata hai.
kauna-sa data dikhata hai: channel ya account names, YouTube @handles jaise identifiers, aur screen par dikhane vala content—jaise video title, description aur comments.
